title: Galleries listing for Oct. 23
text:
CLOSE TO HOME
ARTISTS ’ COOPERATIVE GALLERY OF WESTERLY
14 Railroad Ave., Westerly
401-596-2020; westerlyarts.com
Gallery hours: Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, 1 to 5 p.m.; Friday and Saturday, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
• Through Nov. 2: "All Members" exhibit
HOXIE GALLERY
Westerly Public Library
44 Broad St., Westerly
Library hours: Monday through Thursday, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
• Through October: Dante Society of Westerly presents "Italian Immigrants in Westerly: Their Stories"
JAMES MERRILL HOUSE
107 Water Street, Stonington
Gallery hours: Thursday, 1 to 4 p.m.; Sunday, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
• James Merrill’s World: The Stonington Circle exhibit on display, featuring rare photographs, letters, and artworks.
LA GRUA CENTER
32 Water St., Stonington
860-535-2300; lagruacenter.org
Gallery hours: Wednesday, Friday and Sunday from 1 to 4 p.m. Calling ahead recommended at 860-535-2300.
• Through Oct. 29: Echoes in Motion: Contemporary Dialogues from Guadalaljara, an Exhibition by Verónica Ximénez, María Vargas, & Carlos Garrett Suggested donation $5.
• Nov. 7; 5 to 7 p.m.; Exhibit Opening: Designs from the Flowered Press. Marguerite Alpert creates vibrant pressed botanical artworks from locally grown flowers and plants, capturing and preserving their natural beauty in striking new forms.
MYSTIC MUSEUM OF ART
9 Water St., Mystic
860-536-7601; mysticmuseumofart.org
Museum hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
• Oct. 31: "Going Places," a juried exhibition
• Oct. 31: "Moving to Mystic," showcasing historic artists who joined the Mystic art colony.
MYSTIC SEAPORT MUSEUM
47 Greenmanville Ave., Mystic
888-572-5388; mysticseaport.org
Museum hours: 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily
• Ongoing: "Alexis Rockman Oceanus"
• Through April 2026: "Entwined: Freedom, Sovereignty, and the Sea"
• Through February 2026: "Monstrous: Whaling and Its Colossal Impact"
WESTERLY MUSEUM OF AMERICAN IMPRESSIONISM
79 Watch Hill Road, Westerly
Museum hours: Thursday through Sunday, 10 a.m.-4 p.m.
$12 for adults; $10 for seniors, students and Veterans. Free for members and children under 18.
Timed tickets required for entry. For tickets and more information, visit wmairi.org.
A DRIVE AWAY
COURTHOUSE CENTER FOR THE ARTS
3481 Kingstown Road, West Kingston
• Oct. 28; 5 to 7:30 p.m.; Exhibit Opening: "Beyond the Brush," an exhibit showcasing the works of Rebekah Cook's Children and Adult Studio. To RSVP, visit tickets.courthousearts.org.
LYMAN ALLYN MUSEUM
625 Williams St., New London
860-443-2545; lymanallyn.org
• Through January 18: Allison Gildersleeve: Here Somewhere
• Through Nov. 30: Albrecht Dürer: Master Prints, featuring over 40 woodblock prints and engravings
SOUTH COUNTY ART ASSOCIATION
2587 Kingstown Road, Kingston
401-783-2195; southcountyart.org
Gallery hours: Wednesday-Sunday, 1 to 5 p.m.
• Thursday, Oct. 23, 6 to 8 p.m., opening reception for "All Media Open Juried." The exhibit will be on display through to Nov. 15.
• Nov. 28 to Dec. 20: Holiday pottery and art sale
THAMES RIVER GALLERY
239 Bank St., New London
860-443-0344; thamesrivergallery.com
Hours: Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Saturday, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
• Current exhibition: "Impressionism Then and Now"
HYGIENIC ART GALLERIES
79-83 Bank St., New London
860-443-8001; hygienic.org
Gallery hours: Thursday through Saturday, noon to 7 p.m.; Sunday, noon to 4 p.m.
• Through Oct. 25: "The Art of Ed Jaffe: Madison Ave. to Masterpieces" as well as "If Only Birds Could Sing," a solo exhibition by Aliyah Denea.
THE WILLIAM BENTON MUSEUM OF ART
School of Fine Arts, University of Connecticut, 245 Glennbrook Road, Storrs
860-486-4520; benton@uconn.edu
• Through Dec. 14: Fate and Magic, The Art of Maureen McCabe; Clouds: A Collaboration with Fluid Dynamics; and Encounters with the Collection: Exploring America at 250.
DEBLOIS GALLERY
134 Aquidneck Ave., Middletown
401-847-9977; debloisgallery.com
Gallery hours: Wednesday through Sunday, 1 to 5 p.m.
• Through Oct. 26: "Uncommon," featuring the work of Ralph Bucci FSC, Elizabeth Lamondy, Manjula Padmanabhan and Bill Reis
FLORENCE GRISWOLD MUSEUM
96 Lyme St., Old Lyme
860-434-5542; florencegriswoldmuseum.org
Museum hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.
• Ongoing: "The Art Colony at Old Lyme;" "Connecticut and the Environment," and "The Creative Spark"
• Beginning Sept. 27: "Inside Out: Contexts for American Art" and "Fall into Impressionism"
WICKFORD ART ASSOCIATION
36 Beach St., North Kingstown
401-294-6840; wickfordart.org
• Through Nov. 9: "Every Picture Tells a Story": A juried all photography show.
RISD MUSEUM
224 Benefit St., Providence
401-454-6500. Visit risdmuseum.org for ticket prices and information.
Hours: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Thursday, noon to 8 p.m.
• Through Dec. 14: "Mountain and Water: Selections from China and Japan"
• Through Dec. 30: "A Changing Reflection: Silver, Metalwork, and Jewelry in the 19th-21st Centuries"
